172:t_017:11.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes... $$ランド$$, the others, and I fought him on the $$翠の地球$$.」

172:t_017:12.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Yes... We fought together as allies... then hated each other as enemies...」

172:t_017:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I... don't fight out of hatred.」

172:t_017:14.en:
$$シン$$
(That's right... $$セツコ$$ taught me that...)

172:t_017:15.en:
$$シン$$
(What I have to do now is...!)

172:t_017:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You can do this, $$シン$$, right?」

172:t_018:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It seems you're ready. Now I can crush you without hesitation, $c.」

172:t_018:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... $$ハマーン・カーン$$. You're much kinder than the rumors suggest.」

172:t_018:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$サイデリアル$$... I have not accepted this alliance with you from the bottom of my heart.」

172:t_018:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「My, my... Such bold words, without any regard for your position.」

172:t_018:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Haha... You seem rather different from Mr. $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

172:t_018:7.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Enough joking. Let's both carry out our duties, yes.」

172:t_018:10.en:
$$ハマーン$$
($c, $$シャア$$... I'll simply follow my own path...!)

172:t_018:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, intercept $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and $$サイデリアル$$! Do not attack $$プラント$$!」

172:t_018:12.en:
$$シン$$
「Watch, $$レイ#pt136$$! This is how we fight!」

172:t_019:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「All enemy units have been shot down or withdrawn!」

172:t_019:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$シン$$... There's nothing we can do by staying here.」

172:t_019:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We can intercept enemies attacking us, but we can't seize $$プラント$$.」

172:t_019:5.en:
$$シン$$
「Even so, if we leave things like this...!」

172:t_019:12.en:
$$キラ$$
「...Our enemy is war itself, not $$プラント$$.」

172:t_019:13.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$アスラン$$ and the others are still in $$プラント$$. Let's leave it to them for now.」

172:t_019:15.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, fall back! Hurry!」

172:t_019:16.en:
$$シン$$
($$レイ#pt136$$... I'll... stop you, no matter what...)

172:t_020:0.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「$$シン$$... Everyone... I'll... fight of my own will...」

172:t_020:1.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
(《$$ギル$$》... I finally understand... what you were trying to do...)

172:t_021:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「This ends here, $$ハマーン$$! If you intend to keep fighting...」

172:t_021:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Who do you think you're talking to...!」

172:t_021:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Colonel $$シャア$$ fights with his own strength, without relying on $$ジオン$$'s name! And you...」

172:t_021:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Shut up, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$! I no longer need $$シャア$$!」

172:t_021:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I'll change this world my own way!」

172:t_022:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Chasing her is pointless, $$カミーユ$$. You can't do anything with a woman when she's like that.」

172:t_022:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「It is, $$カトル$$. My instincts say so, too.」

172:t_022:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
($$ハマーン$$... Has the $$赤い彗星$$ captured your heart, too...?)

172:t_023:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hahaha... I can't laugh at $$ギルター$$ after this. I'll have to go back and make excuses to the boss.」

172:t_023:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Until we meet again, $$セツコ$$. My boss wants that, too.」

172:t_024:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'll repay this debt to him and his master together someday.」

172:t_025:1.en:
$n
「I can't stay an inexperienced rookie forever.」

172:t_025:2.en:
$n
(I... have to get stronger... to protect what I care about...!)

172:t_026:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's amazing teamwork... We can't let them outdo us, $n.」

172:t_026:1.en:
$n
「I know...! Here we go, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

172:t_026:2.en:
$n
(I... have to get stronger... to protect what I care about...!)

172:t_100:0.en:
$$シン$$
(Who gives a damn how $$コーディネイター$$s began...! I'm me!)

172:t_100:1.en:
$$シン$$
(I won't be bound by the ties of the past! I'll fight for what I believe in!)

172:t_101:0.en:
$$キラ$$
($$ラクス$$... You've endured all this since learning the truth, haven't you?)

172:t_101:1.en:
$$キラ$$
(Starting today, I'll carry half that burden... And...)

172:t_101:2.en:
$$キラ$$
(I'll grasp the peace and future you want... no matter what... with these feelings and this power!)

172:t_102:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ really is moving its main forces to the $$蒼の地球$$...」

172:t_102:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'll stop them... and the chain of sorrow...!」

172:t_102:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「With our pride... the $$バルゴラ$$, now possessing this new power!」

172:t_103:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$! I'll take you and the $$ユニコーン$$ to obtain $$ラプラスの箱$$!」

172:t_103:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「My father entrusted this $$ガンダム$$ to me...! And $$オードリー$$ entrusted the Box to me!」

172:t_103:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$ミネバ$$ entrusted it to you...?!」

172:t_103:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$! If you want to stop the war with $$オードリー$$, go to Colonel $$シャア$$!」

172:t_103:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Captain $$ジンネマン$$ and $$マリーダ$$ are there, too!」

172:t_103:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I see... The Princess is with that man...」

172:t_103:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So he moves people around solely for his own convenience!」

172:t_103:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's not it, $$ハマーン$$!」

172:t_103:8.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't be so familiar! Don't think being the key to the Box guarantees your safety!」
